recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It preserves the WG decision not to remove eld-5 while ensuring the existing example that implements FHIR-6927 is accurate for the current build; no further FHIR-6927 work is recommended.
issue_request: FHIR-6927 was a Published FHIR-core Change Request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to remove eld-5 because nameReference and fixed[x] exclusivity appeared to prevent constraining child elements of a named slice; the accepted resolution instead kept the rule and required an example showing how to achieve that profiling pattern.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 8e041a80dbcf7621980d5cc620e88cf9554fc4bb, imported from svn revision 6519, with the message '#6927, #5473, #5474, #8285 - add slicing exmaples, bring documentation up to date'. That commit updated source/profiling.html's slicing example rather than deleting eld-5.
additional_context: The old nameReference mechanism has evolved into ElementDefinition.contentReference, and current eld-5 prevents combining contentReference with fixed/pattern-like constraints in definitions. Current profiling source already explains slice child constraints using sliceName and child ids such as Observation.component:systolic.code, but source/profiling.html still had obsolete wording inherited from older Observation.related/name terminology.
reconciliation: Changed only source/profiling.html to describe the example in current terms: component code instead of Observation name, fixed LOINC code without 'for the name', and component/slice wording instead of related item/target resource wording. No new example was added because source/profiling-examples.html already contains the detailed StructureDefinition example requested by the issue.
source_changes: source/profiling.html: corrected the blood-pressure slicing narrative to use current Observation.component and component-code terminology and to avoid stale target-resource wording.

related_jiras.note: Same ballot request as FHIR-6927; not separately decided because FHIR-6927 is the published issue reconciled here.
Later ElementDefinition interpretation-table corrections touched the same nameReference-era material but did not change the current slicing-example reconciliation.
